h1Prompt: A real architectural photograph of a finished alpine garden, brought gently to life. Very slow, perfectly steady push-in toward the stepping-stone path, about 4% over the whole clip. Warm late-afternoon light. The lawn and larch trees stir in a faint mountain breeze. Everything built stays perfectly still and identical to the photo: flagstones, bollard lights, larch fence, chalet. Calm, premium, photorealistic.
h1NegativePrompt: morphing, warping, new objects, extra plants, people, animals, text, logos, camera shake, fast motion, lens flare, colour shift, HDR, CGI look, time-lapse

entries.check: Frames at 0, 1.25, 2.5, 3.75 and 4.9 s compared with the source photo: PSNR 31.6 / 31.5 / 31.5 / 31.5 / 31.5 dB (stable); consecutive sampled frames 40–43 dB. Flagstones, bollard lights, larch fence, bench, boulder and trees unchanged; nothing appears. Motion is a barely perceptible push-in with leaf movement.
Same check as take 1: PSNR 31.6 / 31.4 / 31.4 / 31.4 / 31.5 dB vs source; consecutive frames 40–43 dB; no changes to built elements. Kept as alternate; take 1 is used on the page.

entries.reason: Adds a sunset lens flare through the trees and a warm colour shift from about 1 s to 4 s (PSNR vs source drops from 24 dB to 17.6 dB at 2.5 s), which the negative prompt forbids. Built elements stay in place, but the look no longer matches Germa's photo.

notes: 2026-10-15 round 2: 5 R submissions were refused with a 429 rate limit by the gpt_image_2_5 backend and 3 of them were resubmitted; 2 takes per R prompt instead of 4 to stay within the budget.
2026-10-15 round 3: the procedural three.js maquette was replaced by a Kling 3.0 sequence (C1–C4) scrubbed as WebP frames; see IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
2026-10-16: Living Garden film = T1+T2+T3 joined (11.3 s), exported as WebP frames; no 1080p pass and no AI living loop by the user's decision; atmosphere done in CSS.

2026-10-16 round 4: six aerial clips of a different villa (A1–A6, generated outside this session on 2026-10-15) were reviewed and kept as references in content/media/higgsfield/A; the exploration of our villa is generated as chained Wan clips E1–E4 from K6, budget floor 600 credits.
